0022600037.text: The Chicago Bulls, 1-9 through 10 games and on an eight-game losing streak, host the Atlanta Hawks, who are 7-5 and first in the Southeast, in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup, with Chicago 0-4 at home. Chicago is without Caleb Wilson (hand), Dailyn Swain (back), Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Tobe Awaka (back), all day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), all listed as out. The Hawks come in having lost their last game after going 5-5 over their last ten, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Bulls won the 2025-26 series 3-0, most recently 126-123 in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
